Dex Description: Nocthyrme moves across frozen ground almost silently. Its crystalline mane catches moonlight only after it has already surrounded its target.
Implementation Notes: Starter-line species; provisional numeric ID until progression-based Monsterdex renumber.

Dex Description: Hailhorn travels frozen ridgelines in small herds, using its curved ice horns to break crusted snow and test rivals before winter storms.
Implementation Notes: Restored Frostuft family middle evolution; displayed Dex number comes from Full Dex Order v2.

Dex Description: Gloamfawn appears along old memorial paths at dusk. Small leaves sprout from its spectral antlers wherever it pauses to listen to lingering memories.
Implementation Notes: Restored Wispling family middle evolution; displayed Dex number comes from Full Dex Order v2.

Dex Description: Emberrook is associated with Dragonspine. The missing middle stage of the Ashwing line.
Veilpaca is associated with Mirefen. A tall spectral alpaca whose fleece trails into soft ghost-fire ribbons.
Steelstork is associated with Iron Dominion. A long-legged steel stork with a needle-like beak, piston joints and overlapping riveted wing plates.
Amberruptor is associated with Dragonspine. A revived raptor fossil with narrow running legs, hooked claws and a feather-like fossil crest.
Implementation Notes: Fossil-restored species; market only after legal restoration/discovery.

Dex Description: Fernplate is associated with Greenreach. A revived stegosaur fossil with a low head, broad body and two staggered rows of tall rune-carved plates.
Implementation Notes: Fossil-restored species; market only after legal restoration/discovery.

Dex Description: Hoornvault is associated with Stonehollow. A revived ceratopsian fossil built like a mobile vault.
Implementation Notes: Fossil-restored species; market only after legal restoration/discovery.

Dex Description: Tidespine is associated with Mistwater Coast. A revived spinosaur fossil with a narrow crocodilian snout and a tall sail made from exposed fossil spines.
Implementation Notes: Fossil-restored species; market only after legal restoration/discovery.

Dex Description: Pillarneck is associated with Stonehollow. A colossal revived sauropod whose neck resembles a weathered stone column.
Implementation Notes: Fossil-restored species; market only after legal restoration/discovery.

Dex Description: Shadejackal is associated with The Rift. A lean supernatural jackal with elongated ears, a smoke-like mane and a tail that separates into two shadow ribbons.
Frostbasil is associated with Frostmarch. An epic ice basilisk with a low reptilian body, crown-like frost crystals and rows of blade-shaped scales.
Terradrake is associated with Dragonspine. An epic burrowing dragon built around a broad shovel-shaped brow, compact plated torso and oversized digging claws.
Abysswyrm is associated with The Deep. An epic abyssal dragon with a long ribbon body, pressure-adapted fins and a luminous jawline.
Umbralisk is associated with The Rift. An epic shadow dragon with six low limbs, crescent horns and a segmented void-plated spine.
Scarabrex is associated with Crystal Depths. An epic scarab-dragon with six legs, heavy beetle elytra and a crown of dragon-like horn plates.
Warmaw is associated with Dragonspine. An epic fighting dragon built like a close-range arena bruiser, with massive forearms, a squared jaw and small balance wings.
Hearthscale is associated with Aurelia. An epic Normal/Dragon species with broad neutral-colored scales, a calm heavy stance and a rounded horn crown.
Moonjackal is associated with Aurelia. An epic moonlit jackal with crescent-shaped ears, star markings and multiple elegant ribbon tails.
Petalnix is associated with Greenreach. An epic fairy antelope whose antlers branch into petal clusters and whose shoulders carry a living flower mantle.
Starimp is associated with Stormpeak. An epic fairy trickster with oversized star-shaped ears, a comet-like tail and orbiting electric charms.
Lullacorn is associated with Aurelia. An epic dream-beast combining a tall camelid body with one spiral horn, cloud-like fleece and concentric psychic halos.
Wispmoth is associated with Mirefen. An epic fairy moth with broad stained-glass wings, a glowing lantern abdomen and long feathered antennae.
Tidebelle is associated with Mistwater Coast. An epic Fairy/Water reef creature with a shell-like crown, ribbon fins and pearl-shaped bell ornaments.
Gleamgoyle is associated with Crystal Depths. An epic prismatic gargoyle with a squat carved-stone body, angular crystal wings and a gem brow crest.
